svg.title: RAG: turn a memory problem into a reading problem
svg.desc: Offline: split documents into chunks, embed them, and store vectors and text in an index. Online: retrieve top-k passages with BM25 and dense search, add them to the question prompt, and generate an answer with citations.

g.text: Ground answers in sources: RAG reduces hallucinations, but cannot eliminate them.
RAG: turn a memory problem into a reading problem
Keep changing knowledge in an external index; give the model only the passages relevant to the question.
